scientific_integrity: Exact channel and elementary transform derivation; finite numerical checks are corroborative only. General renewal-channel methods and equal-time static correlations are prior art. No independent publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Ideal instantaneous global Poisson resets; noninteracting 1D displaced harmonic trap; distinct-factor ordered two-time quantum-regression covariance; no statements about same-particle measurement backaction, entanglement, or finite-data estimation.
title: A unique optimal anticorrelation lag in a Poisson-reset quantum Bose gas
